item.title: Germany's Schleswig-Holstein Completes Migration to Open Source Email
item.description:
📝 Microsoft Booted Out, AgainSchleswig-Holstein has successfully migrated (in Deutsch) its entire state administration email system from Microsoft Exchange and Outlook to open source alternatives, Open-Xchange and Thunderbird. This includes the State Chancellery, ministries, judiciary, state police, and other state authorities. German State Ditches Microsoft for Open-Source SoftwareThe end of dominance for Microsoft in this German state, replacing Windows with Linux, and Office with Libreoffice.
🔗 Read more: https://news.itsfoss.com/schleswig-holstein-email-system-migration/
